preparation.captureScope: Station scene and procedural sky only. All other direct island children and crossing lens halos are temporarily hidden; physical traffic lamps remain.
preparation.type: RGBA binary16 HalfFloat; independent 2D target per face render, no mipmaps
preparation.encoding: PNG RGB8 = sRGB(linearRGB / max(2, peakRGB)); alpha255. Linear radiance up to 2 is preserved, brighter texels retain RGB ratios. Bottom row0 is PNG row0, no flip. Runtime sRGB decode *2 with CubeTexture.flipY=false; face order px,nx,py,ny,pz,nz.
